en_title: New Avengers: Doomsday Posters Reveal Key Characters and Tease Thor’s Odinforce
cn_title: 《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》新海报揭晓关键角色，暗示雷神拥有奥丁之力
opus_summary: 漫威发布《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》11张连体海报，呈现多方英雄对抗毁灭博士及其大军，并首次展示毁灭机器人。雷神的武器召唤出黄色闪电，引发粉丝猜测他获得了奥丁之力。影片将于12月18日上映。

paragraphs.en: Apparently, no one told Marvel that GTA VI is out today, because they've been busy showing off new glimpses of Avengers: Doomsday. In addition to a behind-the-scenes video featuring Robert Downey, Jr. , Marvel has also revealed a massive lineup of posters showcasing the film's ensemble cast.
paragraphs.cn: 显然，没人告诉漫威《GTA VI》今天发售，因为他们一直忙着展示《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》的新画面。除了发布一段有小罗伯特·唐尼出镜的幕后视频，漫威还公布了大量海报，展示影片的群星阵容。

paragraphs.en: These 11 posters form one large montage showing the combined forces of the X-Men, Fantastic Four, and Avengers in battle against Downey's Doctor Doom and his army of Sentinels and Doombots. Get a closer look at all these connecting posters in the slideshow gallery below:
paragraphs.cn: 这11张海报组成了一幅大型拼图，展现X战警、神奇四侠和复仇者联盟联手对抗唐尼饰演的毁灭博士，以及他的哨兵和末日机器人军队。在下方幻灯片图集中仔细看看所有这些相互连接的海报：

paragraphs.en: These images tease some interesting new details for the film, like giving us a better look at Alan Cumming's Nightcrawler in costume and showcasing the Doombots (Doctor Doom's android servants/bodyguards) for the first time.
paragraphs.cn: 这些图片透露了影片一些有趣的新细节，比如让我们更清楚地看到了艾伦·卡明饰演的夜行者穿上战衣的样子，还首次展示了末日机器人（毁灭博士的人造人仆从兼保镖）。

paragraphs.en: Perhaps most interesting is the poster featuring Chris Hemsworth's Thor and Chris Evans' Steve Rogers. Steve is wielding Mjolnir and channeling the weapon's signature blue lightning, but Thor's Stormbreaker is instead summoning yellow lightning. This has already led fans to speculate that Thor is now empowered by the Odinforce, signalling a major power upgrade for this already mighty Avenger. Though if the Doomsday trailers are any indication, that's not going to be enough to stop Doom.
paragraphs.cn: 或许最有意思的是克里斯·海姆斯沃斯饰演的雷神和克里斯·埃文斯饰演的史蒂夫·罗杰斯同框的海报。史蒂夫挥舞着雷神之锤，引出这件武器标志性的蓝色闪电，而雷神的风暴战斧召唤出的却是黄色闪电。这已经让粉丝猜测，雷神如今拥有了奥丁之力，意味着这位本就强大的复仇者实力获得了大幅提升。不过，如果《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》的预告片能说明什么的话，这还不足以阻止毁灭博士。

paragraphs.en: We also have to wonder if the character pairings in these posters are significant and meant to tease various team-ups in the film. Certainly, Steve and Thor have a long history together. And we doubt it was merely coincidence that Marvel chose to pair Vanessa Kirby's Invisible Woman and Tenoch Huerta's Namor, given the (mostly one-sided) romantic attachment they share in the comics.
paragraphs.cn: 我们也不禁好奇，这些海报中的角色搭配是否有特殊意义，是否在暗示影片中各种角色的联手。史蒂夫和雷神当然有着长久的交情。考虑到漫画中两人之间存在的感情纠葛（大多是单方面的），我们也不认为漫威选择将凡妮莎·柯比饰演的隐形女和特诺切·韦尔塔饰演的纳摩放在一起仅仅是巧合。

paragraphs.en: But what about the rest of the posters? Will Channing Tatum's Gambit partner up with Florence Pugh's Yelena Belova? What about Tom Hiddleston's Loki and Rebecca Romijn's Mystique? We'll have to wait until Doomsday hits theaters on December 18 to find out.
paragraphs.cn: 但其他海报又意味着什么？查宁·塔图姆饰演的牌皇会和弗洛伦丝·皮尤饰演的叶莲娜·贝洛娃搭档吗？汤姆·希德勒斯顿饰演的洛基和丽贝卡·罗梅恩饰演的魔形女又会如何？我们得等到《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》12月18日上映才能知道。

paragraphs.en: In the meantime, Marvel has already begun teasing Doomsday's sequel, 2027's Avengers: Secret Wars, revealing that the film will be very different in terms of tone and genre . We've also learned that R yan Reynolds and Hugh Jackman have been given writing credits on Doomsday , suggesting that Deadpool and Wolverine will appear in the film.
paragraphs.cn: 与此同时，漫威已经开始为《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》的续集、2027年的《复仇者联盟6：秘密战争》预热，透露这部影片在基调和类型上会截然不同。我们还得知，瑞安·雷诺兹和休·杰克曼在《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》中获得了编剧署名，这暗示死侍和金刚狼将会在影片中登场。
